title: Inżynier serwisu
text:
Naszą misją jest przewodzenie transformacji przemysłowej poprzez promowanie innowacji i zrównoważonego rozwoju. Od optymalizacji centrów danych i przyspieszenia produkcji wodoru, po zrewolucjonizowanie systemów chłodniczych i HVAC — nasze rozwiązania termiczne dla infrastruktury krytycznej zwiększają możliwości przemysłu na całym świecie. Nasz globalny zespół, zjednoczony pod nazwą "One Kelvion", dostarcza innowacyjne rozwiązania, które napędzają sukces klientów i wspierają zrównoważoną przyszłość.

Razem, kształtujemy przyszłość

Twój zakres obowiązków:



- Nadzorowanie i wspieranie instalacji i uruchomienia wymienników ciepła Kelvion i powiązanych systemów u klientów. 
- Współpraca z zespołami instalacyjnymi i wykonawcami w celu zapewnienia prawidłowego montażu zgodnie z dokumentacją techniczną i normami bezpieczeństwa. 
- Przeprowadzanie inspekcji na miejscu w celu weryfikacji prawidłowej instalacji, ustawienia i podłączenia urządzeń. 
- Przeprowadzanie testów funkcjonalnych i wsparcie rozruchu systemu w celu zapewnienia optymalnej wydajności i zgodności ze specyfikacją. 
- Pełnienie funkcji osoby kontaktowej ds. technicznych podczas prac na miejscu, rozwiązując wszelkie problemy lub nieprawidłowości we współpracy z kierownikami projektów i zespołami inżynierskimi. 
- Przygotowywanie szczegółowych raportów z miejsca, w tym protokołów, list kontrolnych i dokumentacji fotograficznej. 
- Udzielanie klientom i personelowi instalacyjnemu wskazówek technicznych dotyczących prawidłowej obsługi i konserwacji produktów Kelvion. 
- Zapewnienie, że wszystkie prace są wykonywane zgodnie z wymogami HSE (Bezpieczeństwo, Higiena Pracy i Środowisko) oraz procedurami firmy. 
- Częste podróże do lokalizacji klientów (krajowych i międzynarodowych) w celu wsparcia działań serwisowych w terenie. 

Nasze oczekiwania:



- Gotowość i zdolność do częstych podróży służbowych po Polsce i Europie (warunek konieczny)
- Biegła znajomość czytania i interpretacji dokumentacji technicznej
- Wykształcenie minimum techniczne (preferowane kierunki: elektrotechnika, mechatronika, automatyka lub budowa maszyn)
- Co najmniej 3-letnie doświadczenie praktyczne w serwisie lub konserwacji urządzeń mechanicznych i/lub elektrycznych
- Ważne uprawnienia SEP (uprawnienia elektryczne)
- Ważne prawo jazdy kategorii B
- Biegła znajomość pakietu MS Office
- Dobra znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie, wystarczająca do efektywnej komunikacji z klientami

Preferowane kwalifikacje:



- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w dziale serwisu w firmie produkcyjnej

To oferujemy:



- Pracę w międzynarodowej firmie o ugruntowanej pozycji na rynku. 
- Pracę z doświadczonym zespołem. 
- To, co nas wyróżnia, to unikatowa kultura organizacyjna. 
- Oprócz wynagrodzenia podstawowego masz możliwość uzyskania premii miesięcznej. 
- Realne perspektywy rozwoju – rośniesz razem z firmą. 
- Dbamy o zdrowie naszych pracowników, dlatego w ofercie mamy, dofinansowanie do karty Multisport oraz prywatnej opieki medycznej. 
- Jako firma ciągle się rozwijamy i Ty też będziesz mieć taką możliwość uczestnicząc w szeregu szkoleń wewnętrznych i zewnętrznych. 
- Masz możliwość uczestniczenia w tworzeniu projektów dla klientów znanych na całym świecie. 

W Kelvion rozwijamy się dzięki współpracy, akceptując różnorodność myśli i ceniąc każdy głos. W naszej organizacji kreatywność kwitnie, ponieważ ludzie są słuchani, ich wkład jest doceniany, a ich pomysły mile widziane. Nasze elastyczne podejście do sposobu w jaki pracujemy, stawia zdrowie i zadowolenie ludzi na pierwszym miejscu, zwiększając zaangażowanie i wspierając możliwości kariery. Umożliwiamy zaangażowanym osobom rozwój, postęp i wytyczanie własnych ścieżek w firmie.

title: Sourcing & Procurement Data Analyst
text:
Department: Operations

Location: EMEA-Poland

Description

In this role, you will take ownership of collecting, cleaning, and analyzing a variety of procurement data that will provide our team vital insights to enhance sourcing strategies, improve supplier performance, and realize process efficiencies.

You will be part of a matrixed global team with peers based in San Jose – CA, Raleigh – NC, Rotkreuz – CH, Wroclaw – PL, Juarez – MX, and Ziyang – CN.

Role expectations



-  Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that track KPIs such as sourcing contributions, spend under management, supplier performance, procurement process SLAs, and policy compliance
-  Lead data cleansing, enrichment, and classification efforts to improve data quality and reporting accuracy
-  Partner with category managers to support sourcing initiatives with data-driven insights
-  Analyze procurement and sourcing data to identify cost-saving opportunities, supplier consolidation, and risk mitigation strategies
-  Assist in the development and execution of sourcing events (RFx, direct negotiations), including spend data collection and bid response analysis/scorecards
-  Participate in continuous improvement projects to enhance sourcing operations and procurement processes; identifying process inefficiencies and recommending solutions
-  Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards for MRP validation, applying planning assumptions and buffer logic
-  Execute and monitor MRP processes in SAP APO/ECC, including BOM management, inventory analysis, and demand-supply alignment
-  Prepare and upload forecasts for long-term planning, ensuring accurate data integration and adjustments across regions
-  Collaborate with procurement and sourcing teams to align purchase orders, resolve supply issues, and communicate planning updates

What We're Looking For



-  B.A./B.S. or equivalent experience
-  3-5 years of relevant experience in procurement, supply chain, or a similar data-driven role within finance
-  Able to interpret rough requirements/goals & effectively translate complex data into clear, insightful findings
-  Strong attention to detail; ability to identity inaccuracies & discrepancies
-  Familiarity with SQL or other database languages & PowerBI
-  Advanced Excel for forecast templates, data validation, and scenario analysis
-  Strong understanding of MRP principles, demand-supply planning, and inventory optimization
-  Ability to navigate through a matrixed organization & collaborate in a cross-regional team

Additional Information

Additionally, the position is eligible for an annual bonus of up to 10% of the annual base salary.

title: HVDC Commissioning Engineer (f/m/d)
text:
We welcome applications from candidates across Poland, as this role is primarily based on international project assignments and not tied to a specific local office location.

A Snapshot of Your Day

In this role, you will ensure the seamless and timely commissioning of HVDC systems on site, while executing and documenting advanced testing activities for Control & Protection hardware and software. You will also prepare test procedures, coordinate factory and workshop tests with suppliers, and support quality, risk, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.

How You’ll Make An Impact



- Ensure technically flawless and timely commissioning of HVDC systems on site, including testing of HV primary components and associated secondary systems.
- Perform integration and functional testing of HVDC control technology (Control & Protection hardware and software) in our test center in Germany.
- Execute and document Functional Performance Tests (FPT), Dynamic Performance Tests (DPT) of our C&P Hardware and Software including Customer Acceptance Tests.
- Develop and prepare detailed testing procedures and test programs for the C&P Hardware, including the necessary verification documentation.
- Plan, coordinate, and evaluate workshop tests (Factory Acceptance Tests) at sub-supplier facilities.
- Support Commissioning Management in quality, risk, and claim management activities, and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives (e.g., Lean, reviews, lessons learned).


What You Bring



- Completed studies in electrical engineering, energy technology or comparable education / qualification; ideally combined with practical experience in electrical engineering and commissioning of electrical power stations.
- Solid knowledge in one or more of the following areas: project planning and testing via MATLAB/SIMULINK, Siemens SIMATIC TDC/S7, CFC, grid protection systems / protection relays & BCUs (DIGSI / SIPROTEC V4/5)
- Knowledge or experience in the field of HVDC systems, particularly in High Voltage Transmission Technology, Control, Measurement, Protection, and Communication Systems
- Understanding of Current- and Voltage Measuring devices and other primary equipment as well as network protection, C&P systems and other secondary systems
- Fluency in English, additional languages are a plus
- Willingness for worldwide business trips and mainly long-term assignments on construction sites in Germany and abroad, as well as optional assignments on offshore platforms


About The Team

Our Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

title: Intern QA Engineer
text:
Ryanair Labs are currently recruiting for an Intern QA Engineer to join Europe’s Largest Airline Group!

Ryanair Labs is the technology brand of Ryanair. Labs is a state of-the-art digital & IT innovation hub creating Europe’s Leading Travel Experience for our customers.

We are launching a 3 month full-time paid IT Internship Program which will give you the opportunity to work within the Ryanair Labs Teams. After successful completion there will be a possibility of extending the cooperation on fixed-term civil contract / contract of employment and then prospect of staying with us long term!

We are looking for people available to attend our office for 40 hours per week – 8 hours daily from Monday to Friday (regular business hours starting between 8:00–9:30).

We are seeking individuals who have a story to tell and who have strong outside interests. Cultural fit at Ryanair is just as important as academics.

We are currently looking for talents in the field of Manual Software Testing. You will be paired up with our Senior QA Engineers who help your career take off! You will be working across our web or mobile projects, internal and dedicated to our customers.

The Role



- Learn and apply QA methodologies, tools, and testing frameworks.
- Partner up with the QA team in verifying software quality through manual testing activities.
- Execute test cases and accurately report defects, errors, or unexpected results.
- Assist in creating, maintaining, or updating test documentation.
- Collaborate with agile team members: testers, developers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
- Attend Agile (Scrum or Kanban) meetings – contribute as appropriate.
- Student / absolvent in a field of Computer Science or any IT background
- Good command of English (min. B2)
- Basic knowledge of manual software testing
- Hands-on experience with leading QA technologies.
- Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
- Opportunity to work on meaningful projects that impact the organization.
- A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
- Potential for future career opportunities within the company.

Recruitment process



- Application form – send us your application in English plus short introduction of yourself, and why you want to join the IT Internship Program.

- Phone call – short conversation with Recruiter when we will share with you all the details about work and we will speak about your expectations and future. Also we will check your English level.
- Interview – technical interview with the Team and then Team Manager.
- Offer – if we’re a match, we’ll present you with an offer and schedule your start day with us!

During each of above steps we’ll be happy to answer any questions you may have. Apply today to discuss the role in more detail!

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki - Wrocław, Bielany Wrocławskie 2027
text:
Description

Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.

Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:

Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin

Key job responsibilities

Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.

Kluczowe Obowiązki Stanowiska



-  Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników
-  Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy
-  Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych
-  Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.
-  Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.
-  Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.
-  Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.
-  Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.

A day in the life

Dzień z życia stażysty

Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.

About The Team

O zespole

Społeczność Stażystów

text:
Description

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Skills

As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:



-  Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
-  Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement

title: Quant Modeling Specialist - Intern
text:
Job Type

Temporary / Contract

Job Reference #

345022BR

City

Kraków, Wroclaw

Key Responsibilities

Are you interested in applying data science, statistics and econometrics to real-world problems in global finance? Do you enjoy working with data, building models and understanding what drives financial performance?

We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst Intern to join our PPNR Stress Testing team. You will work alongside experienced quantitative analysts and gain hands-on experience in developing and applying models used to understand how financial businesses may perform under different economic scenarios.

In this role, you will:



-  Develop and enhance quantitative projection models using time-series data, regression techniques and other statistical and econometric approaches.
-  Work with large financial and economic datasets, using Python to explore data, identify relationships and translate analytical findings into modelling solutions.
-  Build and improve analytical tools supporting model testing, diagnostics, performance monitoring and efficient model execution.
-  Support model calibration, testing and implementation, gaining practical experience with the end-to-end model development lifecycle.
-  Contribute to high-quality model documentation, clearly explaining methodology, assumptions, limitations and analytical results.
-  Gain exposure to model validation and governance, supporting models as they progress through independent review and approval processes.
-  Collaborate with quantitative analysts, business experts and other stakeholders on model development, implementation and review.
-  Support quarterly model execution and analysis, helping the team understand and explain model results under baseline and hypothetical stress scenarios.
-  Prepare clear analyses and presentations that communicate quantitative results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

The team

Banking regulators around the world require systemically important financial institutions to demonstrate their ability to withstand adverse economic conditions through processes commonly referred to as stress testing. This makes quantitative modelling an important part of risk and capital management.

You will join our PPNR Stress Testing team, where we develop and maintain mathematical and econometric models that project financial performance under baseline and hypothetical stress scenarios over a multi-year horizon.

Our work sits at the intersection of data science, econometrics, finance and risk management. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to see how quantitative techniques learned at university are applied to real financial data and business problems, while developing practical modelling, programming and communication skills.

Your Skills And Experience

We are looking for a student or recent graduate with a strong quantitative mindset and genuine interest in applying analytical methods to finance.

You will ideally have:



-  Current or recently completed studies in a quantitative field such as data science, statistics, econometrics, economics, finance, mathematics, computer science, physics, engineering, or a related discipline.
-  A good foundation in statistics, regression analysis and/or time-series analysis. Familiarity with methods such as ARDL, ECM, ARIMA, VAR or GLM is an advantage, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all of them.
-  Practical experience with Python for data analysis, statistical modelling or machine learning, whether gained through university coursework, research, internships or personal projects.
-  Curiosity about financial markets, banking, economics and risk management. Previous professional experience in finance is not required.
-  The ability to approach problems analytically, work with data and explain your conclusions clearly.
-  Strong written and verbal communication skills and an interest in learning how complex quantitative analysis can be communicated to different audienc

title: CyberSecurity - Interns
text:
About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

We are seeking a proactive Cybersecurity Intern to join our Information Security team. You will gain hands-on experience in threat monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and security compliance while working alongside experienced security professionals.

Program Benefits



- Direct, one-on-one mentorship from seasoned cybersecurity engineers and analysts.
- Real-world exposure to enterprise security architectures and live defense workflows.
- Networking opportunities and potential pathways to full-time roles upon graduation.

What will you be doing?



- Security Monitoring: Assist in analyzing alerts using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools to detect potential threats and suspicious behavior.
- Vulnerability Assessments: Support routine vulnerability scans, document findings, and assist teams with tracking remediation tasks.
- Incident Response Support: Help gather logs, analyze forensic artifacts, and document post-incident reviews during security events.
- Security Awareness & Documentation: Assist in creating employee phishing simulations, training materials, and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and written communication skills.
- Understanding of general security principles (encryption, multi-factor authentication, least privilege).

What will make you stand out?



- Basic scripting knowledge in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for task automation.
- Exposure to software development tools and development environments
- Previous software and cyber security experience with relevant coursework or experience.

title: Konsultant_ka w zespole Cybersecurity Testing and Software Security
Tester manualny
text:
O roli

Dołączysz do dynamicznego zespołu rozwijającego nowoczesne aplikacje internetowe w szybko rosnącej branży iGaming. Nasze platformy cechuje wysoka złożoność i konieczność zapewnienia skalowalności, bezpieczeństwa i niezawodności w środowisku o wysokiej dynamice zmian. To praca skoncentrowana na jakości produktu, w której Twoja uwaga na detale i umiejętność tworzenia solidnej dokumentacji testowej będą kluczowe.

To praca, w której będziesz miał/a realny wpływ na procesy testowania, z możliwością tworzenia ich od podstaw w bliskiej współpracy z zespołami deweloperskimi. Nasze projekty bazują na technologiach Vue, Node.js, PHP, React. Dołączysz do zespołu, w którym cenimy proaktywne podejście i zaangażowanie w produkt.

W Naszej Firmie Czeka Na Ciebie



- Udział w procesach testowania aplikacji internetowych, w oparciu o samodzielnie tworzone scenariusze testowe, w tym testy end-to-end we współpracy z testerami automatycznymi. 
- Testowanie zgodności przeglądarek (cross-browser) oraz responsywności aplikacji na urządzeniach desktopowych i mobilnych przy użyciu dedykowanych platform. 
- Tworzenie pełnej dokumentacji testowej: analiza wymagań, rozbijanie na przypadki testowe oraz tworzenie dokładnych raportów błędów. 
- Weryfikowanie wdrożonego interfejsu z projektem graficznym (testy UI) 
- Wspieranie programistów w trakcie rozwoju oprogramowania poprzez kompleksowe testy funkcjonalne i regresyjne – dbamy o to, aby nowe wdrożenia nie psuły działania pozostałych modułów całej aplikacji (wsparcie automatycznej regresji testami manualnymi) 
- Wsparcie zespołu w procesie wdrażania nowych pracowników. 
- Testowanie API (Postman) i dbanie o jakość architektury klient-serwer. 
- Wsparcie działu supportu w rozwiązywaniu trudnych przypadków (bez kontaktu z klientem). 
- Ciągłe doskonalenie procesów testowania aplikacji. 

Nasze Oczekiwania



- Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w pracy jako Manual QA / Tester. 
- Bardzo dobra umiejętność testowania aplikacji internetowych, w tym na urządzeniach mobilnych i desktopowych. 
- Praktyczna umiejętność testowania API (np. Postman). 
- Umiejętność tworzenia i utrzymywania przypadków testowych (test cases) oraz scenariuszy testowych. 
- Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi do inspekcji elementów HTML (DevTools) oraz testowania przeglądarek (np. BrowserStack). 
- Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi do projektowania interfejsów, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem Figmy. 
- Wysoka dbałość o detale (tzw. "oko do szczegółów") i umiejętność weryfikacji wdrożonego interfejsu z projektem graficznym (testy UI/ weryfikacja "Pixel Perfect"). 
- Proaktywne podejście, samodzielność, nastawienie na rezultat, logiczne myślenie i umiejętność brania odpowiedzialności za powierzone zadania.

title: Commissioning Engineer (f/m/d) for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Transmission - DC Protection (DCP)
text:
We welcome applications from candidates across Poland, as this role is primarily based on international project assignments and not tied to a specific local office location.

A Snapshot of Your Day

In our HVDC Protection Team, we are testing and verifying the hardware and software for our innovative HVDC Projects in our Test Center and ensure proper functionality and good quality of our HVDC Plants worldwide during commissioning. Our diverse and multinational teams are working closely together with project management, engineering as well as with end customers to provide customized solutions based on the latest innovations in HVDC technology.

How You’ll Make An Impact



- You actively advance the Energy Transition by bringing our HVDC projects to a successful completion with our customers
- You are part of a project team in Integration Testing and you carry out Functional Tests of the Control & Protection hardware and software in one of our test centers
- You independently trace bugs and support our Software Engineering in debugging
- You are responsible for the execution and documentation of the Functional Performance Tests (FPT) and Dynamic Performance Tests (DPT) of the HVDC System, including Customer Acceptance Tests in one of our test centers
- You are responsible for the commissioning of the Measuring System, the DC Protection System and the Transient Fault Recorder for our HVDC Projects as a part of a highly motivated team, at our customers sites worldwide 
- You support our Commissioning Management in Quality, Risk and Claim Management and you actively participate in our improvement programs


What You Bring



- Completed degree in electrical engineering, energy technology or comparable education / qualification
- Good knowledge in one or more of the following areas: project planning and testing via MATLAB/SIMULINK, Siemens SIMATIC TDC/S7, CFC, grid protection systems
- Knowledge or ideally working experience in the field of Electrical Engineering and Commissioning of Electrical Power Stations or HVDC Systems 
- Expertise in Current- and Voltage Measuring devices and other primary equipment 
- Fluent English language skills, additional languages are a plus
- Willingness for worldwide business trips and mainly long-term assignments on construction sites in Germany and abroad, as well as optional assignments on offshore platforms 


Your opportunities for personal growth: development as Commissioning Manager, Technical Expert or in Project Management

About The Team

Our Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background,

title: QA Software Engineering Expert
text:
Jako tester w naszym zespole transformacyjnym stawisz czoła wyzwaniu nowej generacji: weryfikacji systemów, w których kod współtworzony jest przez agentic AI. Twoim głównym celem będzie dbanie o to, by nowoczesne aplikacje CRM/ERP były nie tylko w pełni funkcjonalne, ale wolne od błędów. W modelu zwinnych, 2-3 osobowych zespołów (taxi-teams) staniesz się kluczowym ogniwem łączącym wizję analityka biznesowego z wygenerowaną rzeczywistością kodu. To rola dla eksperta, który chce redefiniować standardy QA w erze AI.

Profil stanowiska



- Posiadasz min. 5 letnie doświadczenie w testowaniu złożonych aplikacji biznesowych (mile widziane systemy klasy ERP/CRM).
- Posiadasz zaawansowane umiejętności w zakresie tworzenia testów automatycznych (E2E, API).
- Znasz i potrafisz efektywnie wykorzystywać narzędzia do testowania wydajnościowego, co jest kluczowe przy dużej liczbie użytkowników systemów ERP.
- Cechujesz się wybitnie krytycznym myśleniem - potrafisz bezbłędnie "złapać" anomalie i błędy logiczne, które AI mogło ukryć pod pozorem poprawnie wyglądającego kodu.

Twoje zadania



- Automatyzacja testów wspomagana przez AI: Efektywne wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do błyskawicznego generowania zaawansowanych scenariuszy testowych oraz skryptów (np. Playwright, Cypress).
- Weryfikacja zgodności z systemami ERP/CRM: Skrupulatne sprawdzanie, czy nowo powstająca aplikacja webowa zwraca identyczne i poprawne wyniki biznesowe co system źródłowy oparty na kodzie legacy.
- Testy regresji i integracji: Zapewnienie najwyższej stabilności całego ekosystemu w warunkach dynamicznego tempa dostarczania nowych funkcji przez zespoły typu taxi-teams.
- Audyt UX/UI: Bliska współpraca z Product Designerem w celu weryfikacji, czy frontend wygenerowany przez AI jest w 100% zgodny z przyjętym Design Systemem.

Dla Ciebie



- Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych.
- System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy.

- Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT.
- Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe.
- Udogodnienia dla rowerzystów/ rowerzystek (stojaki, szatnie, rowerownie, stacja naprawcza), a dla tych, co do pracy docierają samochodem – naziemny i podziemny parking.

title: С & C++ Embedded Engineer
text:
Team Summary

Our embedded software engineering team's mission is to craft reliable, high-performance solutions that reach millions of homes worldwide within the home security market. We follow agile development methodologies with regular sprint cycles, code reviews, and continuous integration practices. The team's established approach emphasizes comprehensive testing, rigorous security standards, and close collaboration with hardware engineering, product management, and customer support teams. We pride ourselves on writing clean, maintainable code and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

Job Summary

We're seeking a skilled C & C++ Embedded Engineer to take ownership of critical software components in our camera-based security devices. This role involves maintaining existing products through comprehensive debugging and bug fixing, as well as developing innovative new features.

Responsibilities and Duties



- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality embedded software in C and C++ for camera-based security devices.
- Debug and resolve complex software, hardware, and network connectivity issues across the entire software stack.
- Develop new features and improve existing codebases for the product line.
- Optimize software performance for resource-constrained embedded environments.
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to team members.
- Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making processes.
- Collaborate with QA teams to develop comprehensive testing strategies.
- Document software designs, APIs, libraries, and troubleshooting procedures.

Qualifications And Skills



- At least 5+ years of commercial experience in embedded development, with expertise in C and C++ (C++17 standard) and deep knowledge of RTOS and microcontroller architectures (ARM, RISC-V).
- Proficiency in the full SDLC, including professional engineering practices like Git, CMake, code reviews, and continuous integration.
- Solid understanding of network programming and experience with multithreading on multicore microcontrollers.
- Expertise in communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, and Wi-Fi) and experience writing device drivers and libraries.
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex projects.
- Excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation, with a collaborative mindset for cross-functional team environments.
- At least an Upper-Intermediate level in both written and spoken English (B2).
- Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting and debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, etc.) and cross-compilation tool chains.

Nice to have



- Understanding of security protocols and encryption methods
- Experience with Python for scripting and automation
- Experience using AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and code quality

title: Open Source C / Rust Engineer
text:
In our team we develop Renode - an open source development framework for embedded systems that allows you to emulate complicated multi-node environments. We bring what's best in open source software development to the world of embedded, with testing capabilities, continuous integration and rapid prototyping.


As a team member you will work on emulation of various computer architectures, such as RISC-V, ARM or x86. You will be expected to learn the details of various open source operating systems, working on improving the Renode workflow and extending its capabilities. This portion of your job will involve research and exploratory works, pushing tech to the limits. You will be required to analyze the performance of and to create unit tests for your code. You will have to solve complex problems that might include working with assembly, code generation, code translation, interoperability between higher and lower level languages and portability between different OSes. This will require you to work with different codebases in C, Rust and other languages.


Requirements: 



- Bachelor or Master degree in computer science, electronics or related fields
- expertise and readiness to program in C
- practical experience in Rust
- experience and deep understanding of LLVM
- understanding of assembly

- “hacker” mindset
- proficiency in Linux
- great skill in working with large codebases
- willingness to learn about computer architecture
- experience in git
- interest in open source projects
- ability to work with other languages, especially Python
- good command of English
- ability and willingness to learn and work as part of a team
- full-time employment only (no B2B, no agencies)
- permanent residency and eligibility to work in the EU

title: Mechanical Engineer
text:

Our Mechanical Engineering team is responsible for driving innovation from the initial concept through to high-volume production for our key stakeholders' products. We serve as the vital integration hub, bridging the gap between various hardware disciplines, including Radio Frequency, Electrical Engineering, and Optics. Our lab is fully equipped with state-of-the-art tools for rapid prototyping, comprehensive testing, and advanced hardware development, offering a dynamic environment for hands-on engineering.

Job Summary

This role is designed for a self-guided Mechanical Engineer who enjoys driving mechanical innovation from the ground up. You will be responsible for navigating the most challenging aspects of the product development, from initial CAD modeling to design verification and field support. With an ownership mindset, you will guide mechanical components through iterative design cycles, managing everything from material selection to supplier coordination to ensure we deliver on quality, cost, and schedule.

Responsibilities And Duties



- Drive mechanical component development from initial concept to mass production, building high-fidelity CAD models, detailed drawings, and comprehensive BOMs
- Collaborate closely with Electrical, Firmware, and Optical engineers to ensure seamless cross-functional hardware integration and design performance
- Lead mechanical validation tests, such as fit, stress, and thermal analysis, and support design verification through iterative prototyping and lab testing
- Apply expert knowledge of DFM/DFA to optimize designs for performance, cost, and manufacturability
- Lead rigorous design reviews, risk assessments, and FMEAs while managing all engineering documentation and tolerance stack-up analysis
- Coordinate directly with suppliers and internal teams to ensure quality, cost, and schedule milestones are met

Qualifications And Skills



- Proven experience in mechanical design, specifically within consumer electronics, IoT devices, or products with varying IP ratings

- Skilled in performing rigorous tolerance stack-up analysis and using lab tools for hardware validation
- Strong work ethic and an ownership mindset, with the ability to communicate technical risks effectively to stakeholders
- At least an Upper-Intermediate level in both written and spoken English (B2).

Description

About this opportunity

Align Technology is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Payroll EMEA Intern to join our Payroll team. This is a full-time internship opportunity for a student or recent graduate looking to gain hands-on experience in an international payroll environment supporting employees across multiple EMEA countries.

As a Payroll EMEA Intern, you will support and execute payroll activities for assigned EMEA countries while learning about payroll operations, compliance requirements, and best practices. Working closely with Payroll Specialists, HR, Finance, and external payroll providers, you will develop valuable payroll expertise and contribute to the accurate and timely delivery of payroll services.

You will know you have done a great job when you contribute to delivering a high-quality payroll service, maintain a high level of accuracy, and continuously develop your payroll knowledge and skills.

In this role, you will…

- Prepare and validate payroll reports and supporting documentation.
- Support the accurate and timely execution of monthly payrolls in cooperation with internal stakeholders and external payroll provider.

In this role, you'll need…



- University student or recent graduate, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Human Resources, or a related field.
- Strong verbal and written English communication skills (minimum B2 level).
- Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with data.
- Positive, proactive, and eager-to-learn attitude.
- Good organizational and time management skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
- Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- Previous administrative experience would be an advantage but is not required.

What you'll gain



- Structured training in payroll operations within a global organization.
- Hands-on experience processing payroll activities for EMEA countries.
- Mentorship from experienced payroll professionals.
- Exposure to international payroll legislation, compliance requirements, and SOX controls.
- Opportunities to develop analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
- Progressive responsibility and ownership as your knowledge and confidence grow.
- A strong foundation for a future career in Payroll, HR Operations, Finance, or Shared Services.

- Full-time internship contract.
- Opportunity to work in a diverse, international organization.
- Continuous learning and development opportunities.

- Premia od wyniku do 600 zł brutto

- Posiadają wiedzę z zakresu systemów automatyki przemysłowej

title: Mistrz Automatyk
text:
Opis firmy

Jesteśmy wiodącym producentem płyt drewnopochodnych z 125-letnią historią sukcesu, posiadającym ponad 40 zakładów na całym świecie. Jako biznes stawiamy na ciągły rozwój i obecnie realizujemy nowe projekty w obszarze produkcji, logistyki i sprzedaży. Naszym celem jest dalsza ekspansja zarówno rynku krajowego, jak i eksportowego, poprzez oferowanie najnowszych osiągnięć w portfolio produktowym. Dlatego poszukujemy kompetentnych menedżerów i specjalistów, których cechuje pasja i ambicja w dążeniu do osiągania założonych celów.

Opis stanowiska



- Zarządzanie i utrzymanie systemów automatyki przemysłowej.
- Diagnoza i naprawa awarii oraz przeprowadzanie konserwacji urządzeń.
- Optymalizacja procesów automatyki w celu poprawy efektywności i oszczędności.
- Planowanie i nadzór nad projektami związanymi z automatyzacją.
- Współpraca z innymi działami w celu zapewnienia płynności produkcji.
- Opracowywanie i wdrażanie procedur bezpieczeństwa dla systemów automatyki.

Kwalifikacje



- Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne (preferowane kierunki związane z automatyką).
- Doświadczenie zawodowe w obszarze automatyki przemysłowej.
- Mile widziana znajomość sterowników PLC Siemens oraz SCADA.
- Umiejętność czytania schematów elektrycznych i dokumentacji technicznej.
- Zdolność do pracy zarówno samodzielnej, jak i w zespole.
- Dobre umiejętności komunikacyjne i organizacyjne.

Dodatkowe informacje



- Pracę na w pełni zautomatyzowanych liniach produkcyjnych.
- Pracę w największym koncernie w swojej branży.
- Kontakt z najnowszymi technologiami (produkcja, cyfryzacja, AI).
- Możliwość realizacji własnych projektów / pomysłów.
- Szkolenia w kierunku rozwoju kompetencji managerskich / technicznych.
- Stabilne zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę o pracę.
- Atrakcyjny system nagród miesięcznych.
- Opiekę mentora podczas procesu onboarding.
- Rozwój wewnątrz organizacji w ramach rekrutacji wewnętrznych.

title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
text:
As of January 2026, Averna and Spherea joined forces to form the Spherea Group.  A global Test & Quality Solution leader, Averna Powered by Spherea partners with product designers, developers and manufacturers to help them achieve higher product quality, accelerate time to market and protect their brands by covering and offering solutions and expertise for the entire product lifecycle.

Averna Powered by Spherea offers specialized expertise and innovative test, vision inspection, precision assembly and automated solutions that deliver substantial technical, financial and market benefits for clients in the aerospace, automotive, consumer electronics, defense, energy, industrials, medical devices & life sciences, semiconductor, telecom and transportation industries. 

Their solutions include prototyping & consulting, precision assembly & production, automated test solutions, in-line test systems, test system replication, and test platforms & products. Averna Powered by Spherea’s expertise ranges from vision systems, specialized battery test, RF & microwave and fiber optics to robotics & motion, instrumentation, control systems, and data management.

Job Description



- Support the development, standardization, maintenance and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System. 
- Analyze existing processes and identify inefficiencies, duplication, gaps and opportunities for improvement. 
- Partner with Process Owners to map, review and optimize business processes. 
- Monitor process performance using KPIs and other metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities. 
- Support continuous improvement and coordinate their implementation across different regions. 
- Support internal audits and follow-up activities, facilitate root cause analysis, corrective actions and structured problem-solving for recurring process and quality issues. 
- Identify and share best practices across regions and support their implementation globally. 
- Prepare process documentation, guidelines and training materials where needed. 
- Deliver training and awareness sessions related to quality processes, systems and continuous improvement initiatives. 
- Support change management activities to ensure successful adoption of new processes, tools and ways of working. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams to ensure improvements are effectively implemented and sustained. 

Qualifications



- University degree in Engineering, Quality, Process or a related field. 
- Minimum 3 years’ experience in Quality Management, Continuous Improvement, Process Improvement, Process Excellence or a similar role. 
- Knowledge of ISO 9001; and ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001 an asset 
- Experience in conduction and supporting internal audits. 
- Experience with SharePoint, Jira, Confluence, Salesforce or similar digital tools; PLM an asset 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
- A structured and data-driven approach to identifying and solving problems. 
- Ability to work independently and manage improvement activities and projects. 
- Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
- Ability to work effectively in a global and cross-functional environment. 
- Very good English, both written and spoken. 

Additional Information

What's in it for you



- Diverse, supportive, and growth-oriented environment
- Collaboration opportunities with teams across Europe and globally
- Flexible working hours 
- Be part of a company that puts ESG at the heart of its mission, for people, planet, and performance

Averna Powered by Spherea is committed to employment equity and to encouraging diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment, regardless of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Logistics Process Development Engineer
text:
Job Description

Our plant, Stemmann Polska, located in Kąty Wrocławskie, has been part of Wabtec Corporation since 2014.

Wabtec is a global provider of technologies, products, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the rail freight and transit industry. For more than 100 years, Stemmann has been one of the world's leading manufacturers of energy and data transfer components and systems for industrial and transportation applications.

Who will you be working with?

You will be part of the Supply Chain organization and will report directly to the Supply Chain Manager. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Production, Procurement, Quality, and Warehouse Operations to drive logistics excellence, improve operational performance, and support strategic supply chain initiatives.

How will you make a difference?

As a member of the Supply Chain team, you will be responsible for optimizing internal logistics processes and driving continuous improvement initiatives across warehouse and transportation operations. You will lead process implementation, Lean, and system-related projects, while ensuring effective warehouse management system (WMS) functionality and process standardization. This role plays a key part in supporting inventory accuracy, cost optimization, and operational excellence through data-driven decision-making and proactive process development. You will work closely with stakeholders across the organization to identify improvement opportunities and implement sustainable solutions that enhance supply chain performance.

What do we want to know about you?



- Master's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. 
- Minimum 3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably within international transportation, customs clearance, and transport route planning. 
- Strong knowledge of warehouse and transportation documentation, processes, and best practices. 
- Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and ERP systems. 
- Proven ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with carriers and logistics service providers. 
- Experience leading, mentoring, or supporting logistics and warehouse teams. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset. 
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. 
- Lean Manufacturing or Continuous Improvement experience is highly desirable. 
- Fluent in both Polish and English. 

What will your typical day look like?



- Analyze, map, and optimize internal logistics processes to improve efficiency and reduce costs. 
- Lead logistics process improvement, Lean, digitalization, and system implementation projects. 
- Maintain and continuously improve warehouse management system (WMS) structures and functionality. 
- Provide expert support for inventory management, stock reclassification, and scrapping processes. 
- Monitor logistics performance and identify opportunities for operational improvements. 
- Promote and implement a data-driven culture within the logistics organization. 
- Collaborate with Production, Procurement, Quality, and other internal stakeholders to ensure smooth logistics operations. 
- Support transportation planning and logistics execution while maintaining compliance with applicable standards and procedures. 
- Drive operational excellence initiatives and contribute to achieving business objectives. 
- Provide guidance and support to logistics teams to maintain high levels of service and performance. 

Legal authorization to work in the European Union is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. title: Lider Zespołu Inżynierów Procesów Produkcyjnych ds. Slurry
company: Metivo — a Part of BASF Group
text:
O nas: 

Należymy do Grupy BASF ECMS - światowego lidera w katalizie oraz handlu i recyklingu metali szlachetnych.

Łączymy sukces gospodarczy z ochroną środowiska i odpowiedzialnością społeczną.

Wykorzystując swoją dogłębną wiedzę jako światowy lider w katalizie i metalach szlachetnych, firma BASF Environmental Catalyst and Metal Solutions (ECMS) obsługuje klientów z wielu branż, w tym motoryzacyjnej, lotniczej, jakości powietrza w pomieszczeniach, półprzewodników i gospodarki wodorowej. Spółka świadczy także kompleksowe usługi w zakresie handlu i recyklingu metali szlachetnych. Koncentrując się na rozwiązaniach o obiegu zamkniętym i zrównoważonym rozwoju, ECMS angażuje się w pomoc naszym klientom w tworzeniu czystszego i bardziej zrównoważonego świata. Naszym celem jest ochrona elementów naszego życia, co inspiruje nas do wciąż nowych rozwiązań. ECMS działa globalnie w 15 krajach obejmując około 20 zakładów produkcyjnych i ponad 4000 pracowników.

Twoje podstawowe obowiązki:



- Zapewnienie ciągłości i stabilności procesu technologicznego w celu realizacji wymagań klienta dotyczących jakości i terminowości dostaw. 
- Zarządzanie zespołem Inżynierów Procesu obejmujące organizację pracy, planowanie i priorytetyzację zadań, ocenę efektywności, rozwój kompetencji, utrzymywanie matrycy kompetencji, rekrutację, planowanie sukcesji oraz zapewnienie wymaganej dostępności zasobów. 
- Planowanie i priorytetyzacja zadań zespołu inżynierów zgodnie z potrzebami produkcji, projektów i organizacji. 
- Nadzór nad tworzeniem, aktualizacją i zgodnością dokumentacji procesowej, instrukcji technologicznych oraz wytycznych dla produkcji. 
- Zapewnienie szybkiego i skutecznego rozwiązywania problemów technologicznych w celu utrzymania ciągłości produkcji i wymaganej efektywności procesu. 
- Koordynowanie wdrażania nowych produktów, zmian technologicznych, projektów rozwojowych oraz transferów procesów we współpracy z klientami,Process Technology i pozostałymi działami organizacji. 
- Koordynowanie działań korygujących i zapobiegawczych wynikających z audytów wewnętrznych, audytów klientów, reklamacji oraz niezgodności jakościowych. 

Nasze wymagania:



- Wykształcenie wyższe. 
- Minimum pięcoletnie doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku w branży motoryzacyjnej. 
- Zaawansowana znajomość języka angielskiego. 
- Znajomość procesu katalizy
- Znajomość metodyk rozwiazywania problemów, m.in. 8D
- Znajomość narzędzi jakościowych: CP/ PFMEA. 
- Umiejętność rozwijania pracowników poprzez coaching, mentoring i przekazywanie wiedzy eksperckiej. 
- Umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów. 
- Proaktywna Postawa, przedsiębiorcze działanie I inicjowanie usprawnień. 

 To oferujemy: 



-  Wyróżniamy się niestandardowymi benefitami: Program Wsparcia Pracowników EAP, opieka medyczna VIP, karta Lunch Pass oraz darmowy transport pracowniczych na określonych liniach (m.in Legnica, Lubin, Sobótka, Wrocław, Ścinawa). 
-  Znajdziesz u nas także: ubezpieczenie grupowe za złotówkę, dofinansowanie karty MultiSport oraz programy rozwojowe i szereg bezpłatnych szkoleń on-line. Pełny pakiet benefitów znajdziesz tutaj . 
-  Możesz liczyć na: zdobycie doświadczenia w wiodącej firmie chemicznej na świecie, Work Life Balance, możliwość korzystania z pracy zdalnej. 
-  W pracy ważne są dla nas nasze wartości: live integrity, encourage curiosity, appreciate people, deliver results

title: Full-stack Software Engineer (Flutter + Node.js)
text:
Are you ready to take ownership of cutting-edge mobile projects?

We're looking for a proactive, solutions-focused Full-Stack Developer with experience in Flutter and back-end development (NodeJS, Express, Typescript on Google Cloud/Firebase) to join our team. If you enjoy working with autonomy, collaborating on complex challenges, and contributing to meaningful, user-focused digital products, we'd love to hear from you!

About Droids On Roids ⚡️

At the beginning of 2025, Droids On Roids joined forces with Apadmi, a European digital products company specialising in mobile. We create digital experiences that generate measurable value for organisations and their customers. Our group brings together Product, Design, Engineering, Data and AI, Delivery and Growth capabilities across operating companies.

As Apadmi scales, Product is becoming one coherent group capability: shared standards, careers, methods and investment, applied with meaningful authority close to clients and teams.

You might also know us as the organizers of Fluttered Meetup.

What you'll be working on

As a Full-stack developer, you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality mobile solutions across diverse industries, from finance and e-commerce to healthcare and navigation. You'll collaborate closely in a cross-functional team to bring ideas to life and develop features the way you think is best.

Your responsibilities:



- Build cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter, with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience,
- Develop and maintain scalable and reliable back-end services, including RESTful APIs, serverless functions, and databases,
- Work collaboratively with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to define and deliver thoughtful, user-centered features,
- Contribute to system architecture and technical planning across the front end and back end,
- Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and cloud-based services,
- Continuously improve performance, accessibility, and reliability across the stack,
- Actively participate in sprint planning, peer reviews, and team-wide knowledge sharing.

What you'll bring to the team

You're not just a developer - you're a creator, problem solver, and leader in your craft.



- Experience developing mobile apps with Flutter in a commercial or production environment,

Spotkaj się z nami,

Witaj w Erste Bank Polska!

title: Requirements Management Tools Engineer
text:
Job Description

As our organization continues to expand, we are strengthening our development tool landscape to ensure excellence, compliance, and scalability across our global engineering teams. To support this mission, we are looking for a Requirements Management Tools Engineer to join our team.

Requirements



- Maintain the requirements management tools in use (Polarion, 3DS, Jama, R4J) or other requirements management system on the existing infrastructure.
- Understand business requirements for the usage of the requirements management tools in use, and be the referee regarding which tool fits better each use-case.
- Design and develop custom-made solutions for traceability, implementation & test status reports in the requirements management tools in use, with respect to the business requirements from this category of tools.
- Proactively advice & support the Renesas Engineers with usage of the requirements management tools and provide coaching regarding the best practices for requirements management.
- Coach the reports creation and usage of the tools according best practices, tool performance and aSPICE compliance.
- Offer online training for Engineering staff regarding the configuration & usage of the tools in target.
- Understand & drive end-to-end architecture for optimal performance of the tools.
- Be the gatekeeper for the requirements management tools with respect to corporate compliance to standard.
- Explore technologies/solutions for continuous improvements; prime technical Interface for the vendor communication.
- Integrate the requirements management tools with the rest of the development tools in order to implement the best DevOps practices and facilitate the data flow.

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related equivalent
- Proven experience with Polarion, 3DS, Jama, DOORS, DOORS Next Gen, CodeBeamer, Requirements Yogy, R4J, TFS or other similar tools for requirements management or ALM / PLM systems – for both - usage and administration / configuration
- Experience SQL, Javascript or similar technologies used in the landscape of tooling, used for building extension of the basic functionality of the tools in target.
- Knowledge of aSPICE, ISO 26262, TISAX or similar standards can represent an advantage
- Experience or knowledge in the following areas would be advantageous: automotive, tools and methods for software quality assurance, aSPICE, System test, development of safety critical systems, system or software architecture definition
- Knowledge or experience with agile frameworks: Scrum, Kanban or XP.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Additional Information

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

The Field Engineer is responsible for the generator diagnosis, which mainly consists of electrical tests, visual inspections and inspections carried out with robotic systems.

Further responsibilities of the field engineer include planning, organizing, integrating and managing tools and materials required to complete the scope of work in accordance with the contractual requirements. He will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of technical complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning. Required Qualifications

text:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities

- Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale.
- Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability.
- Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends.
- Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain.

title: Quality Engineer

title: Backend / AI Developer - Freelancer
text:
About The Project

We're building an AI Transformation platform for an enterprise client, focused on back-office process automation and AI-driven decision support. The platform brings together data from multiple business systems and puts AI agents on top of it, so that business teams get actionable insights and automated workflows instead of manual routines.

Requirements

What You'll Do



- Integrate data from multiple business sources (CRM, analytics, BI) into a single, cohesive data layer
- Build and deploy AI agents that execute specific business tasks: signal analysis, pricing, content/SEO, data classification and tagging
- Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers: dedicated, read-only, domain-specific servers that expose data to agents and tools
- Do data engineering work: schema design, ETL and synchronization from external systems, and ensuring data quality and consistency
- Contribute to the agent platform architecture: routing layer, cost control, access policies, and telemetry for LLM calls
- Design and build backend APIs connecting the data layer with agents and front-end applications
- Create user-facing tools for business teams, driven by data and agent-generated insights
- Maintain infrastructure: containerization, database management, monitoring, and observability
- Document architectural decisions and keep strict contracts between system layers

Tech Stack

Python



-  FastAPI
-  Agno (agent framework)
-  MCP
-  PostgreSQL
-  Docker / Docker Compose
-  Next.js

What we are looking for: 



- Solid commercial experience (approx. 2 years) in backend development with Python
- Hands-on experience with FastAPI or a comparable modern web framework
- Good knowledge of PostgreSQL: schema design, query writing, and optimization
- Experience building and consuming REST APIs
- Understanding of ETL and data synchronization concepts, and of how to keep data consistent across systems
- Working knowledge of Docker and Docker Compose
- Practical experience with LLMs and prompt writing; interest in building agent-based systems
- Comfort working with agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) in daily development, and the discipline to critically verify their output
- Ability to write clear technical documentation
- Good communication skills and confidence working directly with client-side teams
- English level sufficient for daily communication with the client (B2+ / Upper-Intermediate)

Nice to Have



- Experience with agent frameworks (Agno, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
- Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Basic Next.js / React skills for working on front-end applications
- Experience with observability and monitoring tools
- Experience integrating with CRM, analytics, or BI systems
- Background in enterprise or consulting projects

The Kurt J. Lesker Company is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of vacuum technology solutions that support some of the world's most innovative industries, including semiconductor manufacturing, aerospace, scientific research, optics, and advanced technologies.

Founded in 1954, KJLC has grown from a small family business into a trusted global organisation with facilities and customers across North America, Europe, and Asia. For over 70 years, we have provided innovative vacuum solutions, high-quality manufacturing, and engineering expertise to customers pushing the boundaries of science and technology.

As part of our continued international growth, we are excited to be opening a brand-new facility in Poland and are seeking a talented Manufacturing Design Engineer to join us during this exciting phase of expansion.

The Role

As a Manufacturing Design Engineer, you will play a key role in designing vacuum chambers, custom fabrications, and precision-machined components for a wide range of customer applications. Supporting projects from concept through to manufacture, you will work closely with Production, Planning, Inspection, and suppliers to deliver high-quality solutions that meet technical, quality, and delivery requirements.

Working within a global engineering team, you will collaborate with colleagues across Europe and worldwide, contributing to innovative projects and helping establish our newest European manufacturing facility in Poland.

Key Job Elements:



- Design and detail mechanical components used in the KJLC product lines while following the established procedures
- Meets with Material Control, Key Shop Personnel, and any other resource as required to discuss and understand the entire scope of the project
- Responsible for any manufacturing or sub-contracted challenges that arise
- Work to budgets and timelines relative to project tasks
- Create Bills of Material in the corporate ERP system
- Interface with our internal machine shop to determine cost effective manufacture
- Occasional domestic travel is required (Initial training in UK)
- Other Duties as assigned

Qualifications

Required



- Engineering degree or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering 
- Strong 3D CAD experience
- Working knowledge of GD&T

Preferred



- Experience with Solid Edge or other mid-range modelling package
- Experience of working within a Manufacturing Facility
- Experience of 1-off Custom Design
- Experience of Scientific Vacuum Industry
- Hands on Experience via CNC machining, fabrication or TIG Welding

Why Join us?

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing global organisation and play a key role in establishing our newest European location.



- Competitive salary
- Annual salary review and adjustment
- Relocation bonus (if applicable)
- Jubilee bonus (Tenure scheme) for applicable roles
- Private Healthcare
- Life Insurance
- Enhanced Pension match
- Employee & Family Assistance program
- Development & Technical training for applicable roles
- Workplace perks (e.g Tea/Cofee)
- Annual company events (e.g Summer event/Christmas party)

title: Electrical Engineer
text:
Chemelex is a global leader in electric thermal and sensing solutions, protecting the world’s critical processes, places and people. With over 50 years of innovation and a commitment to excellence, we develop solutions that ensure safety, reliability, and efficiency in diverse environments – from industrial plants and data centers to people’s homes. We deliver future-ready technologies, advanced engineering capabilities and local expertise backed by global standards. Our offering includes a leading portfolio from our trusted brands: Raychem, Tracer, Nuheat and Pyrotenax.


Job Responsibilities

- Prepares technical documentation required for production - electrical diagrams, material list, wiring documentation, assembly instructions and testing instructions.
- Prepares assembly instructions and schematics using an EPLAN/CAD program.
- Creates the electrical/electronic parts of the BOM. Prepares documentation in accordance with the cabinet construction process and the recommendations of IEC standards.
- Performs standard tests as well as additional prototype tests if required.
- Responsible for all issues related to the integration of the prototype, in particular for safety, quality, efficiency, timeliness of work and costs.
- Involvement in all activities related to the prototype and its implementation into production.
- Creates technical specifications, manual and maintenance instructions.
- Prepares project cost calculations.
- Work in a multidisciplinary team during all phases of the project.
- Cooperation with project managers, production, buyers, planners and logistics.
- Work in accordance with the company's main principles of: safety, quality, on-time delivery, standardization of used components and minimization of costs.


Requirements

- Completed studies at the Faculty of Electrical or Electronics of the University of Technology, supported by work experience as an electrical engineer or similar.
- Over 2 years of experience in designing electrical installations. Practical ability to design wiring and electrical installations.
- Work experience with design of electrical diagrams supporting software EPLAN Electric P8, or SEE Electrical Expert.
- Experience in designing and assembling electrical distribution and control systems, prefabrication of low voltage switchgears.
- Knowledge of issues related to the design and production of cable harnesses.
- Knowledge of the issues of electrical integration of cabinets, and experience in certification of products for Ex/ATEX hazardous areas will be an additional advantage.
- Knowledge of English at a level enabling communication in a multilingual team; proficient in Polish. 


Other Information

- This position will be located at Dzierżoniów in a global oriented environment.
- We offer you a full time position with a competitive package and an excellent environment to work, learn & benefits to support the lives of our employees such as: Hybrid working mode, Sodexo card, parking slot, MyBenefit Cafeteria, accident insurance, medical package, Company Social Fund.


At Chemelex
We protect places of progress through electric excellence.
Pioneering plants, sprawling data centers, busy transport hubs, and your own home. These are the places that bring progress to the world, and the places that we protect with time-tested technologies, advanced engineering, and a suite of services. Because here, excellence is everything.

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki - Dobromierz 2027
text:
Description

Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.

Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:

Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin

Key job responsibilities

Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.

Kluczowe Obowiązki Stanowiska



-  Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników
-  Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy
-  Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych
-  Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.
-  Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.
-  Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.
-  Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.
-  Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.

A day in the life

Dzień z życia stażysty

Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.

About The Team

O zespole

Społeczność Stażystów



-  Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowan
